title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A Flask/Dash web application (radx-datagen) that fits a synthetic data generator on temporary health-related tabular data (age, name, disease status) and serves synthetic samples through an API. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic data and uses SDV's run_diagnostic to validate the generated output.
